category_help.longest_rally: Always included when the rally has usable timestamps; may be won or lost.
category_help.slow_recovery: A loss with more than 1.6 m remaining from base one second after an out-of-position trip begins.
category_help.late_rally_speed_drop: A loss over 5 seconds with lower tracked average speed near the rally end than near the start.
category_help.ready_position: A loss with a low wrist-above-shoulder racket-preparation proxy during at least three READY pose samples.
category_help.court_coverage_imbalance: A loss whose front/back court-time shares differ from the player's winning-rally pattern.
category_help.mid_length_rally_loss: A loss lasting more than 5 and up to 10 seconds.
category_help.late_game_pressure_loss: A loss at 20 or higher, or at 17 or higher with a score gap of at most three.
